issue.title: UTable rows shift by a few pixels when sorting
issue.body:
### Environment

- @acme/ui: 1.3.0
- Vue: 3.5.13

### Description

When I click a sortable column header, the rows appear to jump vertically by a couple of pixels for a moment before settling. It's subtle but noticeable on large tables. I don't have a minimal repro handy right now, but it happens on every table with more than 20 rows in our dashboard.

### Expected behavior

Sorting shouldn't cause any layout shift.
issue.author: marcolopez
